control-plane-functional-source.description: Exact canonical hepta-control-plane snapshot, candidate routing, observability and performance aggregation implementations selected by the product control-plane surface, with executable owner tests. The standalone hepta-orchestration-kernel compatibility/experimental crate is intentionally not product evidence.

planner-functional-source.description: Exact bounded optimizer, deterministic fallback, certificate recomputation and stale-snapshot rejection implementation.

hierarchical-resource-source.description: Rust hierarchical ceiling, fairness and bounded-accounting components plus a separate durable lease journal. Tests cover local recovery; mandatory product dispatch integration and trusted terminal reconciliation remain unproved.

production-composition-source.description: Executable local workflow composition over the existing SQLite/CAS, dispatch and commit owners. Exact CLI regressions cover preparation, seven-step execution, absolute replay, revision-bound lifecycle, changed definitions, real Rust children and crash/no-relaunch. This is local workflow source evidence, not full autonomous research, live-model authorship, production composition or Node parity. The autonomous CLI now supplies a live clock through the existing workflow/service/sequencer/SQLite owner; expiry after preparation must retain prepared bytes without commit or relaunch, and earlier committed steps survive later expiry. Explicit local amendment and lease extension also use the same writer with live post-lock/precommit checks against the previous lease; exact replay does not reapply budget or renewal. The CLI additionally propagates SIGINT/SIGTERM through the same existing process-group supervisor and precommit checks; actual-binary tests verify worker/descendant termination, retained ambiguity, no relaunch and prepared replay. This is not automatic renewal, native-kernel preemption, escaped-process containment, remote settlement or full role parity. Sequential cancel-node now treats a committed step as an idempotent no-op and terminally fences an uncommitted step plus its dependent suffix while preserving ambiguous attempt evidence. The actual local CLI and exact owner test are bound here; arbitrary DAG cancellation and production infrastructure teardown remain open. The local broker-prepared consumer now feeds the existing CAS/verifier/SQLite path through ordinary service and workflow entrypoints. Its tests use a local protocol peer, not a live provider; request issuance, automatic model dispatch, scientific acceptance and commit-bound ACK remain open. The explicit broker execution backend sends one independently signed request, queries its result into the existing CAS/sequencer, uses query-only unresolved recovery and the live execution CLI clock. Dynamic role request issuance, scientific acceptance, invoicing, commit-bound ACK and installed activation remain open.

legacy-adapter-functional-source.description: Exact Node legacy adapter planning, prepared-result execution, replay, cancellation and authority-escalation rejection implementation.

scheduler-boundary-regressions-source.description: Exact Rust hard-rate arithmetic, calibration integrity, dependency-safe Pareto reduction and bounded planner regression tests.

native-state-provisioning-source.description: Native ten-database provisioning plus the exact historical 5+5 partial-root repair. The repair binds an exact read-only plan, exclusive locks on all five existing databases, restore-verified rescue, canonical construction of five missing business databases, scoped supervisor-journal repair, no-clobber publication and deterministic crash reconciliation. These source paths remain non-authorizing: online writer activation, target-host qualification and Node retirement are separate.
